priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: After the disposer returned by `attach` is invoked, subsequent messages still call the stale handler. Repeated attach/dispose cycles accumulate listeners and retain captured state.

findings.title: [P2] Clear the polling interval during cleanup
findings.body: After the disposer returned by `startPolling` is invoked, `refresh` continues running every second because the interval handle is discarded. This leaks periodic work and can keep the process alive.
